summary: MFA + Audit Trail security hardening tests completed. All 31 backend tests pass (18 security + 7 nudges + 6 MFA/audit). Full TOTP MFA lifecycle verified: setup, QR code, enable with backup codes, 2-step login flow, replay protection, backup code login, disable (non-master-admin only). Audit trail verified for org.branding.updated, auth.logout. Frontend MFA UI working: AccountPanel shows MFASetupCard with Enable/Disable buttons, QR code display, code input.
critical_code_review_comments: TOTP MFA implementation uses pyotp with Fernet encryption for secrets at rest
Backup codes are bcrypt-hashed and single-use (marked used after consumption)
Replay protection via mfa_used_codes collection with TTL index (120s)
Master admin cannot disable MFA (403 enforced in /auth/mfa/disable)
MFA login returns temp_token (5-min TTL) requiring /auth/mfa/verify step 2
Audit trail writes to security_audit_log collection with fail-closed behavior
Public endpoint rate limiting: 60 requests/300s per IP on /supplier/case/{token} and /onboarding/public/{token}
Frontend MFASetupCard component properly handles all MFA states (idle, enrolling, backup, disabling)
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up test user mfa-test-1776808659@example.com for MFA flow testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: MFA security hardening complete. All 31 tests pass when run separately (Motor event loop binding requires separate pytest invocations). MFA endpoints: GET /auth/mfa/status, POST /auth/mfa/setup, POST /auth/mfa/enable (returns 10 backup codes), GET /auth/mfa/qrcode, POST /auth/mfa/verify (2-step login), POST /auth/mfa/disable. Audit trail writes to security_audit_log for: org.branding.updated, staff.role.changed, staff.removed, integration.config.updated, equipment.deleted, auth.logout, mfa.enabled, mfa.disabled, mfa.verify.success, mfa.verify.fail.
